round1: Chrissy led Round 1 with 22 points for the third year running, while Jaclyn trailed with 9. Nobody picked Anaheim to beat Detroit, and Anaheim swept them in four, which is the first of two times this postseason that the Ducks made the pool look silly.
round2: Marc took the lead with 15 points as the only person to nail Ottawa in six games. Stephanie picked the wrong team in all four series and scored 6 points anyway, because she guessed some of the game counts right while backing the wrong horse.
round3: Marc, Chrissy and Ottawa's fans all learned the same lesson: Ottawa lost to New Jersey in seven, and four of you had picked them. Only Jaclyn took the Devils, and she led the round with a modest 6 points.
round4: Everyone picked Anaheim, New Jersey won in seven, and the entire pool scored zero. You came together as a group to be completely wrong about the Cup, and the standings did not move.
overall: Marc won his first pool with 34 points, the lowest winning score the pool has seen, which is fitting for a year in which the final round paid out nothing at all. Chrissy was second at 28 and Derrick finished last at 20. Jaclyn has now picked the wrong Cup winner six years in a row and Derrick three, so the pool's Cup picks remain an extremely consistent source of disappointment.
